scene sky
The morning arrives unceremoniously, and with it comes the inherent desire to fall back asleep and ignore the customary closing ceremony entirely.
lines.zh: 清晨毫无仪式感地到来了,随之而来的是那种本能的欲望——想重新睡回去,把照例要举行的闭幕式彻底无视掉。

lines.en: I say this not only as someone who isn’t excited to hear the results, but as someone who has already experienced {i}one{/i} timeskip during this exact event. And I’d much prefer to not have to do that again.
lines.zh: 我这么说,不只是因为我对结果没什么兴趣,还因为我已经在这场活动里经历过{i}一次{/i}时间跳跃了。而我非常不想再来一次。

lines.en: Also, you’ll probably be proud to hear that I went to bed normally and allowed Imani and Wakana to sleep through the night this time.
lines.zh: 另外,你听了大概会为我骄傲——这次我正常上床睡了觉,让 Imani 和 Wakana 安安稳稳睡了一整夜。

lines.en: And yes, it wasn’t a comfortable night for me as I’m far more used to an actual bed than a futon, but at least they allowed me to stay outside of the closet rather than locking me in it.
lines.zh: 没错,这一晚对我来说并不舒服,因为我更习惯真正的床而不是榻榻米,但至少她们允许我待在衣柜外面,而不是把我锁在里面。

lines.en: Because, honestly, if they tried, I likely would have let them.
lines.zh: 因为说实话,如果她们真要那么做,我多半也会由着她们。

lines.en: I did not end last night in a good place — but that will all change today.
lines.zh: 昨晚结束时我的状态并不好——但今天一切都会改变。

lines.en: Today, I will go back to normal and live my life as a normal guy who likes normal things and does normal stuff.
lines.zh: 今天,我要回到正常,像一个喜欢正常东西、做正常事的正常人那样过我的日子。

lines.en: I am no longer a danger to society.
lines.zh: 我不再是社会的危害了。

lines.en: I am reformed and ready to live happily ever after.
lines.zh: 我已经洗心革面,准备好从此幸福地生活下去了。

lines.en: scene beachwarsend1
But of course that all changes the moment I walk past Kirin and Noriko being lesbians on my way to meet up with everyone else.
lines.zh: 当然,在我去和大家会合的路上、路过正在百合的 Kirin 和 Noriko 身边的那一刻,这一切就全变了。

lines.en: I clearly still have a long way to go.
lines.zh: 显然,我还有很长的路要走。

lines.en: But I don’t need to rush as much as I have been.
lines.zh: 但我不需要像之前那样着急了。

lines.en: My time here is endless after all.
lines.zh: 毕竟我在这里的时间是无穷无尽的。

lines.en: And nothing will ever go wrong again.
lines.zh: 而且再也不会出任何差错了。

lines.en: : Noriko, have I ever told you how beautiful you are?
lines.zh: : Noriko,我有说过你有多美吗?

lines.en: : Yes. Mostly while I’m getting dressed. And for what I imagine is the thousandth time now, thank you. I think you’re cute too.
lines.zh: : 说过。多半是在我穿衣服的时候。还有,我想这大概是第一千次了吧,谢谢你。我也觉得你很可爱。

lines.en: : Cute? Or beautiful?
lines.zh: : 可爱?还是美?

lines.en: : Cute. But not, like...innocent-cute. The kind of cute where a little girl is crying in the grocery store because her mom won’t buy her ice cream and she tries to put on a strong face even though she really wants it.
lines.zh: : 可爱。不过不是那种……天真无邪的可爱。是那种小女孩在杂货店里哭,因为妈妈不肯给她买冰淇淋,而她明明很想要却还硬撑着一脸坚强时的那种可爱。

lines.en: : You know what? I’ll take it. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗?我认了。谢啦。

lines.en: : Any time. That’s what friends are for.
lines.zh: : 随时奉陪。朋友就是干这个的。

lines.en: : Kirin...are you a lesbian?
lines.zh: : Kirin……你是女同性恋吗?

lines.en: scene beachwarsend2
: Oh, Karin. I must not have realized you were there on account of how uninteresting and forgettable you are.
lines.zh: : 哦,Karin。我一定是没注意到你在那儿,毕竟你是那么无趣又容易被人遗忘。

lines.en: : But we walked here {i}together...{/i}
lines.zh: : 可我们是{i}一起{/i}走过来的……

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s why I added the “forgettable” part. Also, no. I like dicks too much to be a lesbian. Girls are hot too, though.
lines.zh: : 是啊,所以我才加了「容易被人遗忘」那部分。还有,不是。我太喜欢鸡巴了,当不了女同性恋。不过女生也很辣就是了。

lines.en: scene beachwarsend3
: I never knew that you felt that way. Thank you for opening up to me. And please know that I’ll support you no matter {i}who{/i} you love.
lines.zh: : 我从不知道你是这么想的。谢谢你对我敞开心扉。还有请记住,不管你爱{i}谁{/i},我都会支持你。

lines.en: : Blech.
scene beachwarsend4
: What do you think it would take to get her to {i}really{/i} come after me? Like in an “I’m telling our parents sort of way.”
lines.zh: : 你觉得要怎么做才能让她{i}真的{/i}来追着我骂?就是那种「我要去告诉爸妈」之类的。

lines.en: : Aww, there you go being cute again. Just instead of it being about ice cream, it’s about how you want your big sister to pay attention to you.
lines.zh: : 哎呀,你又可爱起来了。只不过这次不是因为冰淇淋,而是因为你想让你姐姐多注意你一点。

lines.en: : Bite me.
lines.zh: : 咬我啊。

lines.en: : Sure. Getting frisky in public might get her to scold you for a little while. That’s what you want, right?
lines.zh: : 好啊。在公共场合动手动脚,也许能让她骂你一阵子。那就是你想要的,对吧?

lines.en: : No matter {i}who{/i} you love.
lines.zh: : 不管你爱{i}谁{/i}。

lines.en: : Nah, I’m pretty sure she’d just buy us a “congratulations” card if we did that.
lines.zh: : 才不会,我很确定如果我们那么干,她只会给我们买张「恭喜」卡片。

lines.en: : I’m so happy you’ve found such a good friend.
lines.zh: : 我真为你高兴,你找到了这么好的朋友。

lines.en: scene beachwarsend5
: God, you’re so annoying! Stop being so good and go get corrupted like the rest of us!
lines.zh: : 天啊,你真烦!别再这么好了,跟我们其他人一样堕落去吧!

lines.en: : Ignoring whatever the heck is going on over there, welcome to the closing ceremony for the third annual Super Mega Ultimate Dorm Wars!
lines.zh: : 无视那边到底在搞什么鬼,欢迎来到第三届超级无敌终极宿舍战争的闭幕式!

lines.en: : We’ve had a heck of a good time over the last couple days, haven’t we?
lines.zh: : 过去这几天我们玩得可真开心,是不是啊?

lines.en: : Like...sure! Two of us got lost in the woods! And Miss Watabe almost called the cops on us. And Nodoka was weird again. And Yumi and Tsuneyo almost killed each other.
lines.zh: : 比如……当然啦!我们有两个人在森林里迷了路!Watabe 老师差点叫警察来抓我们。Nodoka 又古怪了一回。Yumi 和 Tsuneyo 差点把对方杀了。

lines.en: scene beachwarsend6
: And four of us didn’t really get to do {i}anything{/i} on the second day. And Sensei has been all over the place. And Noriko killed Rin. And I had to touch a weird fish with a face. And-
lines.zh: : 还有我们四个人第二天基本{i}什么{/i}事都没做成。Sensei 一直到处乱窜。Noriko 干掉了 Rin。我还不得不摸了一条长着脸的怪鱼。还有——

lines.en: : We get it, Uta. It wasn’t a {i}perfect{/i} weekend by any means, but it was still fun. And I say that as one of the four who didn’t really get to do anything on the second day.
lines.zh: : 知道了,Uta。这个周末无论如何都算不上{i}完美{/i},但还是很好玩。而我作为那四个第二天基本没事做的人之一,是这么说的。

lines.en: : We could just avoid this in the future by not combining our special events anymore, you know. With how exciting they are on their own, there’s really no need to cram two into one weekend.
lines.zh: : 以后我们干脆别再把特别活动合并在一起就行了,你们知道吧。它们各自已经够精彩了,真没必要把两个硬塞进同一个周末。

lines.en: scene beachwarsend7
: Well said, Miss Imai!
lines.zh: : 说得好,Imai 小姐!

lines.en: scene beachwarsend8
: Now, the moment you’ve all been waiting for! Or at least...the moment {i}some{/i} of you have been waiting for as a bunch of you seem rather disinterested right now.
lines.zh: : 现在,是你们所有人都在等待的时刻!或者至少……是你们中{i}某些{/i}人在等待的时刻,因为你们中有不少人现在看起来兴趣缺缺。

lines.en: : Just recap the winners for ‘em, Makocchi. Anyone who isn’t paying attention can shove it.
lines.zh: : 直接把获胜名单给他们过一遍,Makocchi。谁没在听就随他去。

lines.en: : Right. Yes. Well, then...
lines.zh: : 好的。是。那么……

lines.en: : In regard to the horror story writing contest, the winner is...Futaba Fukuyama!
lines.zh: : 关于恐怖故事写作比赛,获胜者是……Futaba Fukuyama!

lines.en: : Woo! Congrats to Futaba on beating a robot- she’s not paying attention, is she?
lines.zh: : 哇哦!恭喜 Futaba 打败了一个机器人——她没在听,是吧?

lines.en: : It doesn’t look that way, no.
lines.zh: : 看起来不像在听,是的。

lines.en: : What are you writing, Nodoka?
lines.zh: : 你在写什么,Nodoka?

lines.en: : Nothing, my dear. I’m simply looking over the notes I took yesterday.
lines.zh: : 没什么,亲爱的。我只是在翻看昨天记的笔记。

lines.en: scene beachwarsend9
: You were taking notes yesterday? On what?
lines.zh: : 你昨天做了笔记?关于什么的?

lines.en: : On the people and things I found {i}interesting.{/i}
lines.zh: : 关于我觉得{i}有趣{/i}的人和事。

lines.en: : I’m seeing...Ami’s name...all over the place in there...
lines.zh: : 我看到……Ami 的名字……到处都是……

lines.en: : Yes. Because she is interesting.
lines.zh: : 是的。因为她很有趣。

lines.en: : Well, I...I tried to tell you yesterday, but I wouldn’t mind asking her if the two of you could-
lines.zh: : 嗯,我……我昨天就想跟你说了,不过我不介意替你问问她,你们两个能不能——

lines.en: : There’s no need. I’ll handle it myself. But thank you.
lines.zh: : 不必了。我自己会处理。不过还是谢谢你。

lines.en: scene beachwarsend10
: Oh. Uhh...okay. I suppose that’s fine too...
lines.zh: : 哦。呃……好吧。我想那样也行……

lines.en: : Moving things right along, the next contest winner we’d like to announce is...
lines.zh: : 咱们接着往下走,下一位要公布的比赛获胜者是……

lines.en: : Rin Rokuhara! Who defeated her arch nemesis, Molly MacCormack, in a heated battle of the chefs that no one saw coming!
lines.zh: : Rin Rokuhara!她在一场谁也没预料到的激烈厨艺大战中,击败了自己的死敌 Molly MacCormack!

lines.en: : Dorm 4 sweep! Let’s fucking gooooooo!
lines.zh: : 四号宿舍横扫!冲啊啊啊啊!

lines.en: : Makoto, careful. Your poor competitive spirit is showing again.
lines.zh: : Makoto,小心点。你那可怜的好胜心又露出来了。

lines.en: : Sorry. I’m just excited to start the competition up 2-0.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我只是很兴奋能以 2-0 开局。

lines.en: : Don’t get {i}too{/i} excited, Makoto. We’ve still got eight other contests to read out.
lines.zh: : 别{i}太{/i}兴奋,Makoto。我们还有另外八场比赛要念呢。

lines.en: scene beachwarsend11
: Hey, Otoha. You should give me a reward for winning my contest.
lines.zh: : 嘿,Otoha。我赢了比赛,你该给我个奖励。

lines.en: : Should I? Why’s that?
lines.zh: : 是吗?为什么?

lines.en: : Because I suck and never win at anything, but I somehow {i}did{/i} this year. Which means we should celebrate because this may never happen again.
lines.zh: : 因为我很废,什么都赢不了,可今年不知怎么{i}居然{/i}赢了。这意味着我们该庆祝一下,因为这种事可能再也不会发生了。

lines.en: : Is there something in particular you had in mind?
lines.zh: : 你心里有没有什么特别想要的?

lines.en: : Maaaaaaaaybe?
: Is it something you can say out loud?
lines.zh: : 是能说出口的那种吗?

lines.en: scene beachwarsend12
: Uuuuuuuuuuuhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh...
: You know what? Why don’t you just text it to me?
lines.zh: : 你知道吗?不如你直接发短信告诉我就行?

lines.en: scene beachwarsend13
: Our next competition is one of two we conducted on our own yesterday while the rest of you were off having fun.
lines.zh: : 我们的下一场比赛,是昨天趁你们其他人去玩的时候,我们自己办的两场之一。

lines.en: : And fortunately for the girls of the second floor, this one was won by our very own Io Ichimonji, who defeated Miku Maruyama in a quest to build a raft!
lines.zh: : 而对二楼的女孩们来说是件好事——这一场的获胜者是我们自己的 Io Ichimonji,她在这场造木筏的任务中击败了 Miku Maruyama!

lines.en: : This brings the initial score of the Dorm Wars up to 2-1 with the first floor still one point ahead!
lines.zh: : 这样一来,宿舍战争的比分来到 2-1,一楼依然领先一分!

lines.en: : Sorry for lettin’ ya down, Sana. I’d like to say I tried my hardest, but I know that ain’t the case. Really dropped the ball on this one. Just the ball is a plank of wood or somethin’.
lines.zh: : 抱歉让你失望了,Sana。我想说我尽了最大努力,可我知道根本不是那么回事。这次真的搞砸了。只不过那个「球」是块木板什么的。

lines.en: scene beachwarsend14
: Y...You don’t have to...apologize to me...I...I never really expected you to...win in the...first place...
lines.zh: : 你……你不用……跟我道歉……我……我从一开始就没真的指望你……能赢……

lines.en: : Well thanks for all the faith ya have in me.
lines.zh: : 哎呀,谢谢你对我这么有信心啊。

lines.en: : It’s just...Io is...she...likes to build things...doesn’t she?
lines.zh: : 只是……Io 她……她……喜欢做东西……不是吗?

lines.en: scene beachwarsend15
: Yeah, and she’s like...crazy good at it too! You should’a seen the raft thingy she put together. It managed to carry all four of us.
lines.zh: : 是啊,而且她还……强得离谱!你真该看看她拼出来的那个木筏。它居然能载动我们四个人。

lines.en: : How’d your contest go, by the way? You manage to get a good confession out?
lines.zh: : 顺便问一句,你的比赛怎么样?告白顺利吗?

lines.en: : I...actually don’t know yet...
lines.zh: : 我……其实还不知道……

lines.en: : I left before...Otoha had her turn and...I haven’t really talked to Sensei ever since...
lines.zh: : 我在……轮到 Otoha 之前就走了,而且……从那以后我就没怎么跟 Sensei 说过话……

lines.en: : Think you’ve got a shot? A win now would put us up three to one. And it ain’t like Otoha and Sensei are really “couple” material, ya know?
lines.zh: : 你觉得你有戏吗?现在赢一场就能让我们三比一领先。而且 Otoha 和 Sensei 又不是什么「天生一对」的料,你知道吧?

lines.en: : Are you saying...Sensei and I...{i}are?...{/i}
lines.zh: : 你是说……Sensei 和我……{i}是吗{/i}?……

lines.en: scene beachwarsend16
: Sure. If ya don’t mind gettin’ split in half.
lines.zh: : 当然。只要你不介意被劈成两半。

lines.en: : If I...don’t mind getting-
lines.zh: : 只要我……不介意被——

lines.en: : IN REGARD TO THE CONFESSION BATTLE!
scene beachwarsend17
: Wait! Here we go! The moment of truth!
lines.zh: : 等等!来了!关键时刻!

lines.en: : The winner of the first installment in what we hope will be a brand new contest series is...
lines.zh: : 我们希望这将成为一届全新系列赛事的第一场,它的获胜者是……

lines.en: if sanaconfessionwin == True:
: The {i}only{/i} girl around who’s smaller than yours truly...Sana Sakakibara!
lines.zh: : 方圆之内{i}唯一{/i}一个比本人还矮的女孩……Sana Sakakibara!

lines.en: scene beachwarsend18

: Ayyyyy! Atta girl! Better kiss those lady parts goodbye, though. Sensei’s probably gonna tear ya to shreds if that confession was good enough to have him pick you over one of the coolest girls in school.
lines.zh: : 哎呀呀!好样的!不过你最好先跟你的小妹妹说再见吧。如果那段告白好到能让他选你而不选全校最酷的女孩之一,Sensei 大概会把你撕成碎片。

lines.en: : I...won? He picked me?
lines.zh: : 我……赢了?他选了我?

lines.en: : Sure sounds that way. You excited? How do ya feel pickin’ up a win after Molly took ya down last year?
lines.zh: : 听起来就是这样。你兴奋吗?继去年被 Molly 干掉之后,今年拿下一场,感觉如何?

lines.en: : I feel...really good...actually...
lines.zh: : 我感觉……非常好……真的……

lines.en: : After...Sensei’s reaction yesterday...I wasn’t sure if...if he really...um...
lines.zh: : 在昨天……Sensei 的那个反应之后……我不确定……他是不是真的……嗯……

lines.en: : Well, seemed like whatever you were worryin’ about didn’t matter at all. Either that or Otoha’s confession just {i}really{/i} stunk. But hey, what ya don’t know can’t hurt ya.
lines.zh: : 嗯,看来你担心的那些根本不重要。要么就是 Otoha 的告白{i}实在{/i}烂透了。不过话说回来,不知道的事也伤不到你。

lines.en: else:
: Someone {i}way{/i} too cool for school...and {i}another{/i} member of the second floor, Otoha Okakura!
lines.zh: : 一位{i}酷到不像学生{/i}的家伙……同时{i}也{/i}是二楼的成员,Otoha Okakura!

lines.en: scene beachwarsend19
: Tch. And there goes our lead, just like that.
lines.zh: : 啧。我们的领先优势就这么没了。

lines.en: : Hah...I had a...feeling this would happen...
lines.zh: : 哈……我就……有预感会这样……

lines.en: : My...um...strategy wasn’t as...effective as...I thought it would be...
lines.zh: : 我的……嗯……策略没有……我以为的那么……有效……

lines.en: scene beachwarsend20
: Well, what was the strategy? Gettin’ to Sensei’s heart ain’t as hard as ya might think. He’s a boy through and through.
lines.zh: : 那么,是什么策略?打动 Sensei 的心没你想的那么难。他可是彻头彻尾的男人。

lines.en: : That’s...kind of what I...
lines.zh: : 那个……我大概就是……

lines.en: scene beachwarsend19
: Actually, never mind. I don’t...really want to talk about it...
lines.zh: : 算了,当我没说。我……不太想谈这个……

lines.en: : Tch. Friggin’ Otoha bein’ all cool and stuff. Here’s hopin’ whoever comes next is able to get us back on track.
lines.zh: : 啧。该死的 Otoha 装什么酷。只希望下一个上场的人能把我们拉回正轨。

lines.en: scene beachwarsend21
: As many of you may know, I came up with a brand new challenge this year.
lines.zh: : 你们很多人可能知道,今年我想出了一个全新的挑战项目。

lines.en: : And everyone hated it!
lines.zh: : 而所有人都讨厌它!

lines.en: : Yes. Thank you, Uta. Everyone hated it. But that does not mean the points do not count...despite how much I may {i}want{/i} them not to count as the second floor somehow managed to win.
lines.zh: : 是的。谢谢你,Uta。所有人都讨厌它。但这并不意味着分数不算数……尽管二楼不知怎么赢了,而我多{i}希望{/i}那些分不算。

lines.en: : So congratulations to Tsuneyo and Noriko who have earned two more points for the second floor.
lines.zh: : 那么恭喜 Tsuneyo 和 Noriko,她们为二楼又拿下了两分。

lines.en: : Mwahahaha! We have them right where we want them, Kendo Princess!
lines.zh: : 哇哈哈哈!他们现在正落在我们想要的位置上,剑道公主!

lines.en: : You didn’t even do anything.
lines.zh: : 你根本什么都没做。

lines.en: : Sometimes, when your inclusion will only make the fight harder, it is best to stand off to the side and let your party carry you so you do not ruin things for everyone else.
lines.zh: : 有时候,当你的加入只会让战斗变得更难时,最好就站到一边去,让你的队伍带着你走,免得你把其他人的事都搞砸。

lines.en: : Today is one of those days. And the next round at the tavern will be on my tab as my means of saying thanks.
lines.zh: : 今天就是那种日子。而下一轮酒馆里的酒算我的,以此表达我的谢意。

lines.en: : I do not need a “round at the tavern.” I need you to pay as much attention to me as I pay attention to you. That is the way a friendship should function, and you have disappointed me greatly.
lines.zh: : 我不需要什么「酒馆里的一轮酒」。我需要的是你能像我关注你那样关注我。友谊本该是这样运转的,而你让我大失所望。

lines.en: scene beachwarsend22
: You’re still upset about that?
lines.zh: : 你还在为那件事生气?

lines.en: : I’m furious, bro.
lines.zh: : 我气炸了,老兄。

lines.en: : I meant no disrespect! I just know what I am and am not capable of!
lines.zh: : 我没有不尊重你的意思!我只是清楚自己能做什么、不能做什么!

lines.en: scene beachwarsend23
: Hi. Io here. You can go back to ignoring me forever once I’m done talking. In fact, please do exactly that.
lines.zh: : 嗨。我是 Io。等我说完,你们就可以继续永远无视我了。事实上,请务必这么做。

lines.en: : But anyway, somebody told me the other day that expecting to fail at something is a problem in and of itself.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来,前几天有人跟我说,预期自己会失败本身就是个问题。

lines.en: : She said that anyone is capable of anything so long as they try their hardest. So there’s no challenge ever worth backing away from.
lines.zh: : 她说,只要全力以赴,任何人都能做成任何事。所以从来没有什么挑战值得退缩。

lines.en: : Was she faced with such a challenge? Did she overcome the odds and emerge victorious despite what she and everyone else likely believed?
lines.zh: : 那她自己面对过这样的挑战吗?她有没有逆势翻盘,在她自己和其他所有人都不看好的情况下凯旋?

lines.en: : No. She was wrong and she gave up. So I think the Irish girl isn’t wrong in not following through with something she knows she would suck at. Wasting your energy is stupid.
lines.zh: : 没有。她错了,而且她放弃了。所以我觉得那个爱尔兰女孩没有错——明知道自己不擅长的事,就不该硬撑到底。浪费精力是愚蠢的。

lines.en: scene beachwarsend24
: Ha!
: You are all extremely disappointing.
lines.zh: : 你们都让人失望透顶。

lines.en: scene beachwarsend25
: Our next contest, and arguably the most controversial based on whether or not you think it’s okay for teenage girls to strip for their teacher-
lines.zh: : 我们的下一场比赛,大概也是最有争议的一场,取决于你觉得十几岁的女孩在老师面前脱衣服到底算不算合适——

lines.en: : It’s not. Just so everyone knows, it’s definitely not.
lines.zh: : 不合适。先让大家知道,绝对不合适。

lines.en: : ...is the one where we sent two girls out into the woods without a GPS and expected them to get back within a reasonable amount of time! Boy were we wrong!
lines.zh: : ……就是我们把两个女孩不带 GPS 送进森林、还指望她们能在合理时间内回来的那一场!我们错得有多离谱啊!

lines.en: : But despite that, one girl {i}did{/i} come out on top. And that girl was the one with more experience getting lost than anyone...Yasu Yasui.
lines.zh: : 尽管如此,{i}还是{/i}有一个女孩笑到了最后。而那个女孩,是比任何人都更有迷路经验的人……Yasu Yasui。

lines.en: : Who is also not paying attention.
lines.zh: : 而她也没在听。

lines.en: : Does she ever?
lines.zh: : 她有听过吗?

lines.en: : You okay, Touka? Still upset about Yasu’s contest?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗,Touka?还在为 Yasu 那场比赛不高兴?

lines.en: : How could I {i}not{/i} be when the lot of you decided it was acceptable to put poor Yasu in danger?
lines.zh: : 你们这群人居然觉得把可怜的 Yasu 置于危险之中是可以接受的,我怎么可能{i}不{/i}生气?

lines.en: : Hey, don’t lump me in with them. I think this whole ass contest is stupid as shit.
lines.zh: : 嘿,别把我也算进去。我觉得这整场烂比赛蠢得要死。

lines.en: : And yet you participated this year. Curious.
lines.zh: : 可你今年还是参加了。有意思。

lines.en: scene beachwarsend26
: I only fuckin’ did that because I knew you’d throw a hissy fit if I didn’t.
lines.zh: : 我他妈会参加,只是因为我知道如果我不去,你又要大发雷霆。

lines.en: : Sure. I {i}can{/i} believe that. But I’d much {i}rather{/i} believe that you’re finally coming around to accept just how great Sensei is and that you’ve been wrong about him this whole time. Right, Touka?
lines.zh: : 当然。这个我{i}信{/i}。不过我{i}更愿意{/i}相信,你终于开始接受 Sensei 有多好了,而且你从头到尾都看错了他。对吧,Touka?

lines.en: : While I admit that my initial judgment of him may have been a bit harsh, I am not quite sure if I would preach about his greatness just yet. He still has a long way to come in regard to being a respectable adult.
lines.zh: : 虽然我承认,我最初对他的评价也许有点苛刻,但我不太确定现在就该去宣扬他的伟大。要成为一个值得尊敬的成年人,他还有很长的路要走。

lines.en: : Tsk, tsk, tsk. None of you get it. But that’s fine. I’m the oldest and most mature after all. And if anyone knows best, it’s me.
lines.zh: : 啧啧啧。你们都不懂。不过没关系。毕竟我年纪最大、也最成熟。要说谁最懂,那就是我。

lines.en: scene beachwarsend27
: Yeah, not sure about that one, Chika. Think Princess Tits over here might have you beat in the maturity department.
lines.zh: : 嗯,这一点我可不确定,Chika。我觉得这位「波霸公主」在成熟度上可能赢过你。

lines.en: : Princess...Tits?
lines.zh: : 「波霸……公主」?

lines.en: : Oh, so you can comment on {i}Touka’s{/i} boobs but not mine? Real cool, Yumi. Real cool.
lines.zh: : 哦,所以你能点评 {i}Touka{/i} 的胸,就不能点评我的?真有你的,Yumi。真有你的。

lines.en: scene beachwarsend28
: What is with your weird obsession with getting me to talk about your tits lately?!
lines.zh: : 你最近为什么这么执着地想让我谈论你的胸啊?!

lines.en: : It’s only fair that you pay attention to {i}my{/i} chest when I look at yours all the time.
lines.zh: : 我天天盯着你的看,你关注一下{i}我的{/i},不过分吧。

lines.en: : Stop! That’s literally sexual harassment!
lines.zh: : 住口!这简直就是性骚扰!

lines.en: : And...calling me “Princess Tits” is not?
lines.zh: : 那……叫我「波霸公主」就不是了?

lines.en: : Our next competition is the {i}other{/i} most controversial one we held this year.
lines.zh: : 我们的下一场比赛,是今年举办的{i}另一{/i}场最有争议的比赛。

lines.en: : Which, once again, depends entirely on whether or not you think it’s okay for teenage girls to strip for their teacher.
lines.zh: : 而它又一次完全取决于你觉得十几岁的女孩在老师面前脱衣服到底算不算合适。

lines.en: : Which, once again, it’s not.
lines.zh: : 而它又一次,不合适。

lines.en: if utaswimgrav == True:
scene beachwarsend29
: And the winner of this competition is...Uta Ushibori!
lines.zh: : 而这场比赛的获胜者是……Uta Ushibori!

lines.en: : But don’t ask me how or why because I 100%% would have picked Chika instead!
lines.zh: : 不过别问我怎么赢的、为什么赢的,因为我 100%% 会选 Chika 的!

lines.en: : Great. Now I have to remember that I lost the swimsuit competition {i}on top{/i} of my best friend reminding me she hates my boobs.
lines.zh: : 好极了。现在我得记住,我在泳装比赛里输了,{i}外加{/i}我最好的朋友提醒我她讨厌我的胸。

lines.en: : Wonder if that’s why Shortstack won. Maybe it really was just a tits competition at the end of the day?
lines.zh: : 不知道这是不是「小矮子」赢的原因。也许说到底,这就是一场比胸的比赛?

lines.en: : That’s what I keep telling myself and it doesn’t make this any easier.
lines.zh: : 我一直这么跟自己说,可这也没让我好受一点。

lines.en: : For what it’s worth, I think both of you are quite beautiful. And I’m sure it’s only a matter of personal preference.
lines.zh: : 不管怎么说,我觉得你们两个都很美。而且我敢肯定,这只是个人喜好的问题。

lines.en: : Yeah. And if it ain’t a tits thing, we can just assume our weirdo teacher picked the tiny one since she looks more like a kid than you do.
lines.zh: : 是啊。如果不是因为胸,那我们大可以假设我们那个变态老师挑了小的那个,因为她看起来比你还像小孩。

lines.en: : Thank you, Yumi. I love you. Next year, you can defend my honor by competing in the boobs competition in my place.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你,Yumi。我爱你。明年,你可以替我参加比胸大赛,来捍卫我的荣誉。

lines.en: : Yeah, that ain’t happenin’.
lines.zh: : 行,那不可能。

lines.en: else:
scene beachwarsend30

: And the winner of this competition is Chika Chosokabe because of course it is! Congratulations, Chika! You’re beautiful and sexy and I can’t wait to see you in a maid outfit and I’m going to shut up now!
lines.zh: : 而这场比赛的获胜者是 Chika Chosokabe——不用问也知道!恭喜你,Chika!你又美又性感,我已经等不及想看你穿女仆装的样子了,我要闭嘴了!

lines.en: : Thank you, Uta! You were great too! And you can see me in anything you want {i}whenever{/i} you want.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你,Uta!你也很棒!而且你想看我穿什么、{i}什么时候{/i}想看都行。

lines.en: : Well, that’s a fucking gross thing to say.
lines.zh: : 嗯,这话他妈的真恶心。

lines.en: scene beachwarsend31
: You just don’t get it, Yumi. Girls have to say that kind of stuff to one another so we can build each other up since the world is always trying to drag us down.
lines.zh: : 你就是不懂,Yumi。女孩之间必须得说这种话,好互相撑起来,因为这世界总想把我们拖下去。

lines.en: : The compliments, I get. That shit’s fair. But the “You can see me in anything you want, {i}whenever{/i} you want” bullshit? The fuck is up with that?
lines.zh: : 夸奖那些,我懂。那没问题。可「你想看我穿什么都行,{i}什么时候{/i}都行」这种鬼话?这他妈是怎么回事?

lines.en: : Oh, I just like making Uta blush and I’m pretty sure she has a thing for me.
lines.zh: : 哦,我只是喜欢逗 Uta 脸红,而且我很确定她对我有意思。

lines.en: : And this is probably why Headphones was obsessed with you for a hundred years.
lines.zh: : 这大概就是「耳机妹」对你痴迷了一百年的原因。

lines.en: : Rin hasn’t worn headphones since we first started high school. Also, I didn’t flirt with her on purpose and she was way more awkward than Uta is.
lines.zh: : Rin 从我们上高中起就没戴过耳机了。而且我不是故意跟她调情的,还有她比 Uta 别扭多了。

lines.en: : Also, neither one of you has congratulated me yet and I’m still waiting for it.
lines.zh: : 还有,你们两个都还没恭喜我呢,我还在等。

lines.en: : Congratulations, Chika. You broke several laws very effectively and have set an example for all of us.
lines.zh: : 恭喜你,Chika。你非常高效地触犯了好几条法律,为我们所有人树立了榜样。

lines.en: : Thank you, Touka. Now, Yumi. Your turn.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你,Touka。现在轮到你了,Yumi。

lines.en: : Congrats on...giving a predator a boner?
lines.zh: : 恭喜你……让一个捕食者勃起了?

lines.en: : Thank you as well.
lines.zh: : 也谢谢你。

lines.en: : Oh, also, I won the fishing competition in case anyone was wondering. Which no one probably is since Kirin is all the way over there and no one cares about fishing.
lines.zh: : 哦,还有,我赢了钓鱼比赛,万一有人想知道的话。大概没人想知道吧,毕竟 Kirin 人在那么远的地方,而且没人在乎钓鱼。

lines.en: : Woo! Go Makoto!
lines.zh: : 哇哦!Makoto 加油!

lines.en: scene beachwarsend32
: But that brings us to the announcement of our final competition’s winner! Which was both expected and somehow {i}unexpected{/i} as she received a major handicap thanks to a guest judge!
lines.zh: : 不过这样一来,就到了公布最后一场比赛获胜者的时候了!这个结果既在意料之中,又不知怎么地{i}出人意料{/i},因为她靠一位特邀评委拿到了巨大的优势!

lines.en: : What is this? Why is she just clinging to him and why is no one saying anything about it?
lines.zh: : 这是怎么回事?她为什么就这么黏着他,而且为什么没人说点什么?

lines.en: : Because it’s Ayane and that’s what she does.
lines.zh: : 因为她是 Ayane,而她就是会干这种事。

lines.en: : Yes, but she is supposed to do it in a way that is both less public and less abrasive.
lines.zh: : 是,但她本来应该用一种不那么公开、也不那么刺眼的方式来做的。

lines.en: : There’s nothing abrasive about this, Ami! And I’m totally fine with you taking the other arm if it gets you to stop whining!
lines.zh: : 这一点都不刺眼,Ami!而且你要是能别再抱怨,我完全不介意你挽住他另一条胳膊!

lines.en: scene beachwarsend33
: Is that not abrasive? That had to be abrasive, right? Am I using that word correctly?
lines.zh: : 这还不刺眼吗?这总该算刺眼了吧?我这个词用对了吗?

lines.en: : Is everything okay with you? You seem...different. At least from how you’ve been lately.
lines.zh: : 你还好吗?你看起来……不太一样。至少和你最近的样子比起来。

lines.en: : I just want to know why no one is doing anything about this. That is all.
lines.zh: : 我只是想知道为什么没人对此做点什么。就这样。

lines.en: : Is everything okay, Ayane? You’ve been...really clingy since I got here.
lines.zh: : 你还好吗,Ayane?从我来到这儿起,你就……特别黏人。

lines.en: : I know! And Ami hasn’t done anything about it! It’s like magic, right?
lines.zh: : 我知道!而 Ami 什么都没做!简直像魔法一样,对吧?

lines.en: : That’s not how I’d describe it, no. But, so long as no one else sees a problem with it, I don’t really mind.
lines.zh: : 我不会这么形容,不会。不过只要别人都觉得没问题,我也真的不介意。

lines.en: : Good! Cause I’ll be clinging to you a lot more from this point on and there’s nothing you or anyone else can do about it.
lines.zh: : 太好了!因为从今往后我会更多地黏着你,而你也好、其他任何人也好,都拿这没办法。

lines.en: : Hey, are you guys done talking over there yet? Because we {i}kind of{/i} need to announce that Ami defeated Touka in order to start wrapping things up.
lines.zh: : 嘿,你们那边聊完了吗?因为我们得宣布 Ami 击败了 Touka,好开始收尾了。

lines.en: scene beachwarsend34
: And I think you {i}kind of{/i} just did.
lines.zh: : 而我觉得你{i}基本上{/i}已经宣布了。

lines.en: : Congratulations, Ami! I’m sure you won fair and square and didn’t use any sort of nefarious tactics whatsoever!
lines.zh: : 恭喜你,Ami!我敢肯定你赢得光明正大,绝对没有使用任何卑劣手段!

lines.en: : I don’t even {i}know{/i} how I won that competition! Or what “nefarious” even means!
lines.zh: : 我都不{i}知道{/i}自己是怎么赢下那场比赛的!也不知道「卑劣」到底是什么意思!

lines.en: : Yeah, that tracks.
lines.zh: : 是啊,这很合理。

lines.en: : Ayane, can you maybe get your hands-
lines.zh: : Ayane,你能不能把手——

lines.en: : Nope! I’m here to stay and that’s a thing you’re just going to have to learn how to deal with!
lines.zh: : 不要!我赖定这儿了,而这正是你必须学会去适应的事!

lines.en: scene beachwarsend35
: So! Now that all of the winners have been announced, it’s time for the final tally!
lines.zh: : 那么!既然所有获胜者都公布完毕,就到了最终计分的时刻!

lines.en: if dormwar2tie == False:

: However! There is still the matter of distributing the bonus points from last year’s Dorm Wars winner in lieu of an actual prize! Which may very well tip the scales of {i}this{/i} war in the opposite direction!
lines.zh: : 不过!还有一件事——代替真正的奖品,我们要分配去年宿舍战争胜者的奖励分!这很可能会让{i}这场{/i}战争的天平朝相反的方向倾斜!

lines.en: if dormwar2floor1win == True:
: And since that winner was the first floor, we’ll be adding two more points to their total for this year’s competition! Don’t all scream at once!
lines.zh: : 而既然去年获胜的是一楼,我们将在今年的总分上再给他们加两分!大家别一起尖叫啊!

lines.en: $ beachwarfloor1points += 2
: That being said-
lines.zh: : 话虽如此——

lines.en: elif dormwar2floor2win == True:
: And since the gals of the second floor got that win last year, we’ll be adding two more points to our total for this year’s competition! Heck yeah!
lines.zh: : 而既然二楼的姑娘们去年拿下了那场胜利,我们将在今年的总分上再加两分!太棒了!

lines.zh: : 最终的比分是……

elif beachwarfloor1points > beachwarfloor2points:

elif beachwarfloor2points == beachwarfloor1points:
$ beachwartie = True
: For this year’s Dorm Wars...
lines.zh: : 今年宿舍战争的比分是……

lines.en: if beachwarfloor1win == True:
scene beachwarsend36
: Is [beachwarfloor1points] to [beachwarfloor2points] in favor of the first floor! We did it, girls!
lines.zh: : [beachwarfloor1points] 比 [beachwarfloor2points],一楼获胜!我们做到了,姑娘们!

lines.en: : Congratulations, Makoto. And all of the people not named Makoto who also care this much.
lines.zh: : 恭喜你,Makoto。也恭喜所有不叫 Makoto、却同样这么在乎的人。

lines.en: : And congratulations to my girls for doing your best...we’ll get ‘em next year.
lines.zh: : 也恭喜我的姑娘们尽力了……明年我们再拿下他们。

lines.en: scene beachwarsend38
: So, now that we’re done here...what now? Are we still going to school today?
lines.zh: : 那么,既然这边结束了……接下来怎么办?我们今天还要上学吗?

lines.en: scene beachwarsend39
: Oh, crap! I completely forgot it was Monday!
lines.zh: : 哦,糟了!我完全忘了今天是星期一!

lines.en: elif beachwarfloor2win == True:
scene beachwarsend37
: Is [beachwarfloor2points] to [beachwarfloor1points] with the second floor coming out on top! We did it, y’all!
lines.zh: : [beachwarfloor2points] 比 [beachwarfloor1points],二楼独占鳌头!我们做到了,各位!

lines.en: : And we, regretfully...did not. But I suppose there’s always next year.
lines.zh: : 而我们,很遗憾……没有。不过我想,总有明年的。

lines.en: : And I suppose I’ll start freeing up my schedule for the sleepover so all of you don’t stay at Senpai’s house unchaperoned!
lines.zh: : 而我想我也该开始腾出时间办过夜派对了,免得你们一群人没人看管地待在 Senpai 家!

lines.en: scene beachwarsend38
: So, now that we’re done here...what now? Are we still going to school today?
lines.zh: : 那么,既然这边结束了……接下来怎么办?我们今天还要上学吗?

lines.en: scene beachwarsend39
: Oh, crap! I completely forgot it was Monday!
lines.zh: : 哦,糟了!我完全忘了今天是星期一!

lines.en: elif beachwartie == True:
scene beachwarsend38
: Is [beachwarfloor1points] to [beachwarfloor2points].
lines.zh: : [beachwarfloor1points] 比 [beachwarfloor2points]。

lines.en: : We apparently tied.
lines.zh: : 我们显然打平了。

lines.en: : What does this mean for the sleepover thing, then? Are...Are all twenty of you going to his house?
lines.zh: : 那这对过夜的事意味着什么?你们……你们二十个人全都要去他家?

lines.en: : Sensei, permission to be suffocating for a second?
lines.zh: : Sensei,能不能允许我窒息一会儿?

lines.en: : Permission granted. That’s too many people.
lines.zh: : 批准。人实在太多了。

lines.en: : None of you are coming over! The end!
lines.zh: : 你们谁都不许来!就这样!

lines.en: : What {i}are{/i} we doing? We once again failed to think up a system that would both prevent this from happening or decide what we’re supposed to do in the event of a stalemate.
lines.zh: : 我们{i}在{/i}干什么?我们又一次没能想出一套办法——既能防止这种事发生,又能规定万一陷入僵局该怎么办。

lines.en: : There’s always a coin flip.
lines.zh: : 不是还有抛硬币吗。

lines.en: : Yeah, but that’s boring.
lines.zh: : 是啊,可那太无聊了。

lines.en: : Sure, but the alternative is the two of us ultimately forgetting that we tied this year until we’re distributing the contests for the {i}next{/i} Dorm Wars.
lines.zh: : 是没错,但另一个选择就是,我们两个最终会忘了今年打平这回事,一直忘到给{i}下一届{/i}宿舍战争分配比赛项目的时候。

lines.en: : Well, I don’t know about you, but I’m fine with future Uta handling this problem.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我不知道你怎么想,不过我倒是乐意让未来的 Uta 来处理这个问题。

lines.en: : Yeah, we’ve been here long enough and we still have to go to school today.
lines.zh: : 是啊,我们在这儿待得够久了,而且今天还得去上学。

lines.en: scene beachwarsend39
: Oh, crap! I completely forgot it was Monday!
lines.zh: : 哦,糟了!我完全忘了今天是星期一!

lines.en: scene sky
: Everybody who’s not already packed, get your shit or we’re all going to get in trouble!
lines.zh: : 还没收拾好东西的都给我快点收拾,不然我们全都要挨骂了!

lines.en: : Noriko and I are gonna stay here for the rest of the day! But the rest of you can go have fun!
lines.zh: : Noriko 和我今天剩下的时间都要留在这儿!不过你们其他人可以去玩!

lines.en: : I would also like to stay-
lines.zh: : 我也想留下——

lines.en: : Oh, no! You’re coming with me!
lines.zh: : 哦,不行!你得跟我走!

lines.en: Imani grabs my arm and starts dragging me toward the bus stop. Which means that, by extension, she grabs Ayane as well.
lines.zh: Imani 抓住我的胳膊,开始把我往公交站拖。而这也意味着,她顺带把 Ayane 也一起拖上了。

lines.en: Which, of course, means that Ami has to follow after us. Then Maya.
lines.zh: 而这当然意味着 Ami 也得跟在我们后面。然后是 Maya。

lines.en: Then everyone else.
lines.zh: 然后是其他所有人。

lines.en: scene black
Except Kirin and Noriko, of course. But I suppose we’ll see them again tomorrow.
lines.zh: 当然除了 Kirin 和 Noriko。不过我想明天还能再见到她们。

lines.en: Either way, we managed to make it through yet another installment of the Dorm Wars.
lines.zh: 不管怎样,我们总算熬过了又一届宿舍战争。

lines.en: And once again, I managed to stay sane.
lines.zh: 而我也再一次成功保持了理智。

lines.en: Mostly.
lines.zh: 基本上是。

lines.en: Partially.
lines.zh: 部分是。

lines.en: Not really.
lines.zh: 其实没有。

lines.en: My brain feels like it’s full of worms.
lines.zh: 我的脑子里好像塞满了蠕虫。

lines.en: But that’s okay.
lines.zh: 不过没关系。

lines.en: Because nothing will ever go wrong again.
lines.zh: 因为再也不会出任何差错了。

lines.en: The end.
lines.zh: 完。
